places.name: Lonesome Dove
places.note: Jake goes to buy Lorena a horse; a weeping Xavier begs her to stay and marry him, then pays her and leaves.
places.location_hint: south Texas border town overlooking mesquite flats

places.name: Montana
places.note: Jake is amused that Gus's money will buy Lorena a horse to ride there.

places.name: San Francisco
places.note: Lorena tells Xavier they are bound there; Jake thinks her beauty could attract rich men there; Xavier predicts she'll never arrive.

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: Tinkersley bought Lorena her favorite comb when they first arrived there.

places.name: Galveston
places.note: Xavier proposes they go there and take a boat to California; Lorena wonders why Jake prefers riding.

places.name: California
places.note: Xavier dreams of opening a clean restaurant there with Lorena.

places.name: Denver
places.note: Lorena realizes Galveston is closer than Jake's planned route through Denver.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: Jake already has trouble there over a shooting.

places.name: Baton Rouge
places.note: Lorena's father died there; Xavier's look reminds her of his.
